content.comment_body: Hello, I'm operating a [product_name] within a battery-powered transport system. During use, the battery voltage may fall below 24V, and in such cases, the [product_name] may shut down. Could anyone share how the [product_name] acts when voltage drops and how it responds once power is gradually restored to 24Vdc? I previously encountered similar equipment freezing due to an improper power-down routine not resetting during low-voltage times. Is using a [product_name] [article_no] a good approach, or could this device have the same issues? Any advice would be appreciated!

Which [product_name] model are you using? For example, a [product_name] operating from 20.4 to 28.8VDC, or a [product_name] running from 10.8 to 28.8VDC. Switching to a different [product_name] variant might be a better solution. Regards,

Thank you for the suggestion. Using the 12/24V version is a good idea. I realize I didn't provide full details earlier. The battery voltage ranges from 0 to 40Vdc, converted to 24Vdc by a standard DC/DC converter, but this shuts off below 19V as designed by the manufacturer. My goal is to keep the [product_name] functioning down to about 12Vdc for longer operation. However, I'm also using a DM16 module not available in the 12/24V version. If I replace the DC/DC converter with the [product_name], I believe that could be a solution, but I need confirmation on how it handles powering on/off during charging and discharging. I want to ensure the [product_name] always boots from scratch even if the power hasn't dropped completely to zero. Thanks again!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about how [product_name] handles low supply voltage drops and subsequent recovery, especially in battery-powered environments. Key issues involve potential device instability or unresponsiveness during slow voltage restoration, and doubts about reliable system reboot after low voltage events. Compatibility of expansion modules with varying power options further complicates user decision-making.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to manage low voltage conditions reliably and always reset cleanly when power resumes, regardless of whether the voltage drops to zero. They also seek prolonged operation at lower voltages and compatibility of expansion modules across different product variants.
